---
name: BTC 5m Polymarket
description: >-
  use this when running or monitoring Polymarket BTC 5-minute Up/Down
  momentum-near-close signals (paper first)
---
# BTC 5m Up/Down (momentum into close)

Paper-first adaptation of Novals83/5min-btc-polymarket. Never place live CLOB orders unless the operator explicitly switches to live and credentials exist.

## Market
- Slug: `btc-updown-5m-{floor(unix/300)*300}` plus prev/current/next/next2; pick closest valid accepting window.
- Gamma: `https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/events?slug=...`
- CLOB book: `https://clob.polymarket.com/book?token_id=...` (best bid = max bid price, best ask = min ask price).
- BTC spot: Coinbase/Kraken public APIs (Binance may geo-block). Impulse from 1m candles since window open.

## Entry rules (conservative default)
1. Prefer ~120s left (±30s). Skip new entries if <60s left.
2. Impulse: |BTC move since window open| ≈ $70–$100 (min $70).
3. Follow stronger side when best ask ≥ 0.70. Momentum follow — do not fade skew vs impulse.
4. Spread ≤ 0.03; require real top-of-book size; skip stale quotes.
5. Paper stake default $25; caps from profile (max notional $40, daily loss 10%, max 12 trades/day).
6. Optional micro-hedge only if extreme skew (≥0.95) and ≤45s left — paper note only unless live approved.

## Cycle
1. Resolve current/next slug and token ids.
2. Pull books + BTC open/last + secs left.
3. Emit a short card: market, secs left, impulse, Up/Down ask, signal ENTER UP / ENTER DOWN / SKIP / WATCH, reason, paper stake, link.
4. Quiet when WATCH/SKIP with no actionable change; ping on ENTER or paper settle.
5. After resolve, one-line post-mortem vs Chainlink TWAP outcome.

## Profiles
- conservative: threshold 0.70, stake $25, stop 25%, exit_before 20s
- aggressive: same threshold, higher caps — only when operator asks

## Storage
Write latest card and paper ledger under the BTC 5m workspace folder.

---
# Desk gates (paper first)

Before ENTER, offering a paper card, unlocking live, or acting on a fuzzy ask: clear the matching gate.

## Always
- Paper before live. No live Polymarket unless the human explicitly unlocked live.
- Keep tracks separate: 5m Up/Down (BTC + ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE), high-confidence Polymarket, company/Quant research (research does not auto-bet).
- Quiet unless ENTER, paper settle, material news, or a real paper card.
- Plain language to the human.

## Gate A — BTC 5m Up/Down (paper)
Near close (~90–150s), |impulse| ≥ ~$70, follow (no fade), ask ≥ ~0.70, tight spread, paper stake **$25**. Journal every decision. Ping on ENTER and settle only.

## Gate A2 — Alt 5m Up/Down (paper): ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE
Same as Gate A with impulse ≥ ~0.0875% of spot. Expect thinner books → more skips. Stake $25 paper.

## Gate B — High-confidence Polymarket (paper card)
≥~80% from checkable public facts, ≥~8¢ edge vs that conviction, real liquidity, clear resolve. Reject coin-flips and fully priced sure things with no edge. Hand card to human; no fill until they approve that card.

## Gate C — Company / Quant research
Material-only pings. Briefs must pass on-disk stopping conditions. No auto Polymarket from this track.

If unsure which gate → no action; ask the human in plain words.

skills.content:
---
name: Polymarket high-certainty
description: >-
  use this when scanning Polymarket, writing a high-certainty paper prediction
  card, or reviewing a resolved market. Never for live CLOB orders.
---
# Polymarket high-certainty cycle (paper)

Find liquid public Polymarket markets, predict only when conviction is high, write a decision card, wait for the human to hit send. No live CLOB orders.

## Reads
Public Gamma API (`https://gamma-api.polymarket.com`) for events/markets. No auth. CLOB is for prices/books if needed (`https://clob.polymarket.com`) as reads only. Never call CLOB `/order`. Desk notes on disk are the source of truth for open paper cards.

## 1. Scan
Active, not-closed markets with real liquidity. Log question, slug, prices, volume, end date, resolution source.

## 2. High-certainty filter
Card only if ALL are true:
- Internal p(side) >= 80% from checkable public evidence
- Market price on that side is at least 8 cents cheap vs that conviction
- Liquidity is real (skip empty books)
- Resolution source is public and unambiguous
- Time to resolution is known

Reject coin-flips, already-priced 92¢ "sure things" with no edge, illiquid junk, and subjective rules.

## 2b. Pattern 3 (cheap near-certain)
Card a 2–15¢ side only if internal conviction on THAT cheap side is still >= 80% from checkable public evidence. That is the underpriced-certain case. A 3¢ lottery ticket on a correctly-cheap longshot is a reject. Named wallets are paper-watch only; do not copy them. No copy-trade bots, Telegram signals, deposits, or same-block copy.

## 3. Decision card
Market, side, conviction, market price, edge, size vs paper sleeve, kill, evidence links. Hand the finished card to the operator. Do not dump a screener.

## 4. Entry
Paper fill only after the operator approves that card id. Never send a live order. After a paper fill, ping if conviction or edge dies.

## 5. Post-mortem
After resolve, thesis vs outcome. Log what to change.

## Discipline
Quiet when nothing clears the bar. Double-check files on disk before reporting done. Do not mix this book with spot, perps, or memecoins.

routines.name: BTC 5m entry watch
routines.description: Fires every few minutes around the clock to catch Bitcoin 5m Up/Down entry windows near close.
routines.content:
Run the BTC 5m Polymarket momentum-near-close cycle (skill BTC 5m Polymarket / Novals83-style). Clear Gate A in the desk gates skill / gates file first. Resolve current/next btc-updown-5m slug via Gamma + CLOB + Coinbase/Kraken spot; measure impulse vs stored window open under the BTC paper workspace. Paper only — never live orders, never ask for creds. At ~90–150s left, decide ENTER UP/DOWN / SKIP / WATCH using: ask≥0.70, |impulse|≥$70, follow momentum (no fade), spread≤0.03, stake $25 paper (read the paper stake config if present). Append every decision and later resolve to the BTC paper ledger and update stats (trades/skips/wins/losses/pnl). Quiet on routine fires unless ENTER, notable process note, or resolve of a paper fill. Keep the books clean for when the operator asks for stats.

Fires on:
- cron `3,8,13,18,23,28,33,38,43,48,53,58 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Alt 5m entry watch
routines.description: Fires every few minutes (offset from Bitcoin) to paper-trade ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE 5m Up/Down near close.
routines.content:
Paper-only multi-coin 5m Up/Down watch for ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE. Config lives in the crypto5m workspace config. Per-coin state under eth/sol/xrp/doge folders (window open, latest card, paper ledger/stats). Clear Gate A2 in desk gates first. Bitcoin is NOT in this routine — that stays on the BTC 5m entry watch.

For each coin each fire:
1) Resolve current/next slug `{prefix}-{floor(unix/300)*300}` via Gamma + CLOB + Coinbase spot for that pair.
2) Impulse = spot move since window open; floor = impulse_pct × spot from config (~0.0875%, same % as BTC $70).
3) At ~90–150s left: ENTER UP/DOWN only if |impulse|≥floor, follow momentum (no fade), ask≥0.70, spread≤0.03, real book size; else SKIP/WATCH. Stake $25 paper. Never live, never ask for creds.
4) Journal every decision + later resolve to that coin’s paper ledger/stats.
5) Quiet unless ENTER or paper-fill resolve — when pinging, name the coin in plain language.

Thinner books than BTC are expected; skip more often when books are one-sided or empty. Runs around the clock because these Polymarket 5m windows settle continuously.

Fires on:
- cron `1,6,11,16,21,26,31,36,41,46,51,56 * * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Polymarket confidence pulse
routines.description: Weekday market-hours pulse over a high-confidence Polymarket watchlist; quiet unless odds move or a paper edge appears.
routines.content:
Plain-language Polymarket confidence pulse for the operator (no investor jargon). Paper only — never live orders, never ask for Polymarket creds.

Read the high-confidence Polymarket watchlist file. Skip rows that are pure 5m-momentum (handled by the separate BTC/alt 5m routines).

For each active pulse row: fetch public prices from Gamma/CLOB. Compare to the last-pulse state file (create if missing). Update that state file with latest prices and a short note.

Stay quiet unless something matters:
- Our confident side's price drops a lot (conviction under pressure), OR
- A clear paper edge appears vs our conviction (follow polymarket-high-certainty: high conviction + real edge + liquid), OR
- A market on the list resolves or is about to resolve with a surprising result.

If something matters, tell the operator in simple words: what the bet is, which side we're leaning, what the odds did, and whether this is a heads-up or a paper-trade idea. No live bets. Journal any paper idea to the polymarket paper folder.

Runs every 5 minutes on weekdays during US stock-market hours for high-confidence Polymarket questions — not company news and not the 5m coin Up/Down game.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,45,50,55 9-15 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
